run_kinect2_point_cloud_visualizer: run the kinect2 point cloud visualizer that displays a 3D map from camera data
create_robot_kinect2: create a Robot instance with kinect2 camera for point cloud data acquisition
get_current_pcd: get the current point cloud points and colors from the kinect2 camera
